text:
maria: quick note from today's small bring-up: ran speculative decode on oz-mini-q4 with default alpha=0.2. seeing ~1.6x token throughput on gpu-dev-2.

eli: nice. any obvious quality hits?

maria: small formatting regressions on enumerations and dates (missing 'and', month/day swaps in a few cases). overall EM on our tiny qa set down ~0.4%.

sam: can you share the exact config?

maria: ```MODEL=oz-mini-q4
DECODE=speculative
ALPHA=0.20
MIN_PREFILL=1
LOOKAHEAD=1
BATCH=dynamic
```

noah: fallback rate?

maria: fallback ~2.4% overall, spikes to ~5% for prompts >300 tokens. KV cache hit unchanged.

eli: try alpha=0.12 and min_prefill=2 as a quick conservative sweep. might keep perf while reducing list errors.

maria: launching 5k A/B (alpha 0.12/0.20). turning off temp anneal to isolate.

infra-bot: job 46100 queued on gpu-pool-1 (eta ~4m).

sam: if alpha tuning works we should add a short doc in Optimize recommending alpha<=0.12 for formatted outputs and alpha=0.18-0.22 for freeform chat. include canary checklist.

maria: noted. will post results + CSV diffs to gcs://redwood-dev/mini-spec/1724249999/ when done.
